BURHAN:v3p85/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p85/r1.speaker: ابن النحاس
BURHAN:v3p85/r1.claim: Ibn al-Nahhas says this is the intended verse; the interrogative hamza turns ليس from negation into confirmation, making the construction exceptional in analogy rather than usage.
BURHAN:v3p85/r1.anchor: ابن النحاس أنه أراد الآية الآولى أعنى قوله

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p204/r4.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p204/r4.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p204/r4.claim: The surah sustains its opening focus on Resurrection through repeated scenes of the Last Day and returns to it in the final challenge to revive the dead.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p204/r4.anchor: أما يوم القيامة، فقد تكررت أحواله في السورة في تناسق لطيف، إلى أن ختمت بقوله: {أَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p234/r3.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p234/r3.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p234/r3.claim: The question whether humanity is left neglected links back to the oath, gathering bones, the record of deeds, the preceding threat, and the closing proof of God's power to resurrect.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p234/r3.anchor: هذه الآية مرتبطة بأول السورة، وهو القَسم بيوم القيامة، ومرتبطة بقوله تعالى: {أَيَحْسَبُ الإنسان أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُ}

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p236/r4.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p236/r4.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p236/r4.claim: The unspoken subject of laysa is the demonstrative dhalika, pointing to an unstated entity; this matches the omitted agents in preceding actions, and the ending echoes the opening's Resurrection oath.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p236/r4.anchor: اسم (ليس) مكنيٌّ غير مصرّح به وهو اسم الإشارة (ذلك)

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p236/r5.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p236/r5.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p236/r5.claim: Raising the dead seems harder than reshaping fingertips to human reason, although all divine acts are equal; the question form and emphatic ba therefore underscore the importance of resurrection.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p236/r5.anchor: إحياء الموتى أصعب وأعسر من تسوية البنان في القياس العقلي

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p237/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p237/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p237/r1.claim: The explicit bala qadirin affirms finger-shaping but omits its verb and circumstantial subject; the complete, emphatic question about reviving the dead marks its greater rhetorical weight.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p237/r1.anchor: فدلَّ ذلك على الفرق بين المقامين

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p239/r9.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p239/r9.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p239/r9.claim: It pairs divine power to shape fingertips with power to revive the dead, using direct affirmation for the first and an interrogative affirmation for the second.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT:p239/r9.anchor: وذكرت نوعين من القدرة: القدرة على تسوية البنان

AKHFASH:v2p558/r2.author: al-Akhfash al-Awsaṭ
AKHFASH:v2p558/r2.speaker: some
AKHFASH:v2p558/r2.claim: Some read يحي الموتى with the final yāʾ hidden between assimilation and clear pronunciation.
AKHFASH:v2p558/r2.anchor: وقال {على أن يحيي الموتى} وقال بعضهم {يحي الموتى} فأخفى وجعله بين الادغام وغير الادغام

AKHFASH:v2p558/r3.author: al-Akhfash al-Awsaṭ
AKHFASH:v2p558/r3.speaker: author
AKHFASH:v2p558/r3.claim: Full assimilation is unsuitable because the final yāʾ alternates in يحيا and disappears in the jussive; only intermediate concealment is possible.
AKHFASH:v2p558/r3.anchor: ولا يستقيم ان تكون ها هنا مدغما لأن الياء الآخرة ليست تثبت على حال واحد [اذ] تصير الفا في قولك "يحيا" وتحذف في الجزم

NAHHAS:v5p92/r19.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p92/r19.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p92/r19.claim: The verse makes clear that reviving the dead is no more difficult than creating a human from a drop and forming him until he has offspring.
NAHHAS:v5p92/r19.anchor: فدل جل وعز دلالة بينة أن إحياءه إياه بعد الموت ليس بأكثر من خلقه إياه من نطفة ثم سواه إنسانا إلى أن ولد له

NAHHAS:v5p92/r20.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p92/r20.speaker: الفراء
NAHHAS:v5p92/r20.claim: Al-Farra permits a reading that shifts the first yāʾ’s vowel to the ḥāʾ and assimilates the yāʾ into the following yāʾ.
NAHHAS:v5p92/r20.anchor: وأجاز الفراء ( على أن يحيي الموتى ) بقلب حركة الياء الأولى على الحاء ويدغم الياء في الياء

NAHHAS:v5p92/r21.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p92/r21.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p92/r21.claim: Nahhas, following al-Khalil and Sibawayh, rejects al-Farra’s assimilation: it would bring together two vowelless sounds, its vowel is only accidental, and the nonbasic accusative cannot license it when the nominative does not.
NAHHAS:v5p92/r21.anchor: وهذا خطأ عند الخليل وسيبويه والعلة في ذلك وهو معنى كلام أبي إسحاق أنك إذا قلت يحيى لم يجز الإدغام بإجماع النحويين

SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r1.speaker: العامة
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r1.claim: The common reading has بقادر as an active participle, genitive after an extra bāʾ in the predicate of ليس; Zayd ibn ʿAlī instead reads the imperfect يقدر.
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r1.anchor: وقرأ العامة أيضا " بقادر " اسم فاعل مجرورا بباء زائدة في خبر " ليس ". وزيد بن علي " يقدر " فعلا مضارعا

SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r2.speaker: العامة
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r2.claim: The common reading puts يحيي in the accusative after أن; Ṭalḥah ibn Sulaymān and al-Fayyāḍ ibn Ghazwān read its final weak letter with sukūn, either dropping the case vowel or treating connected speech as a pause.
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r2.anchor: والعامة على نصب " يحيي " ب " أن " لأن الفتحة خفيفة على حرف العلة. وقرأ طلحة بن سليمان والفياض بن غزوان بسكونها

SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r3.speaker: جمهور الناس
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r3.claim: Most require leaving the two yāʾs unassimilated because assimilation would yield two consecutive sukūns, which cannot be pronounced.
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r3.anchor: وجمهور الناس على وجوب فك الإدغام. قال أبو البقاء: " لئلا يجمع بين ساكنين لفظا أو تقديرا "

SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r4.speaker: بعض الناس
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r4.claim: Some permit assimilation, moving the first yāʾ’s vowel onto the ḥāʾ before merging; al-Farrāʾ cites the poetic form فتعي in support.
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r4.anchor: فإن بعض الناس جوز الإدغام في ذلك، وقراءته " أن يحي " وذلك أنه لما أراد الإدغام نقل حركة الياء الأولى إلى الحاء

SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r5.claim: Basran grammarians forbid assimilation because the second yāʾ’s vowel is inflectional and therefore incidental; al-Farrāʾ allows it in the accusative because that yāʾ is vocalized.
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r5.anchor: فأما في حال النصب فقد أجازه الفراء لأجل تحرك الياء الثانية، وهو لا يجوز عند البصريين؛ لأن الحركة عارضة

SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r6.speaker: مكي
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r6.claim: Makkī claims consensus against assimilation in the nominative; al-Samīn rejects this because al-Farrāʾ’s verse فتعي is nominative and assimilated, with the vowel surfacing after assimilation.
SAMIN-DURR:75:40/r6.anchor: وقال مكي: " وقد أجمعوا على عدم الإدغام في حال الرفع.

ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r1.claim: That majestic creator who fashioned this wondrous creation is surely able to revive the dead, which reason deems easier than the first creation.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r1.anchor: أليس ذلك العظيم الشأن الذي أنشأ هذا الإنشاء البديع بقادر أي قادرا

ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r2.speaker: زيد
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r2.claim: Zayd reads the verb as the present tense yaqdir, ‘is able.’

ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r3.claim: Reviving the dead is easier than initiating creation, by rational comparison.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r3.anchor: وهو أهون من البدء في قياس العقل

ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r4.speaker: طلحة بن سليمان والفيض بن غزوان
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r4.claim: Ṭalḥa ibn Sulaymān and al-Fayḍ ibn Ghazwān read yuḥyī with a still yāʾ, normally a pause form; deletion of its inflectional vowel also occurs in poetry.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r4.anchor: وقرأ طلحة بن سليمان والفيض بن غزوان على أن يحيى بسكون الياء وأنتتعلم أن حركاتها حركة إعراب لا تنحذف إلا في الوقف

ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r5.speaker: ابن خالويه
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r5.claim: Ibn Khālawayh says the Basran grammarians, including Sībawayh, disallow assimilation of the two yāʾs because the second is vowelless and its inflectional fatḥa is not permanent.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r5.anchor: قال ابن خالويه لا يجيز أهل البصرة سيبويه وأصحابه إدغام يحييي قالوا لسكون الياء الثانية

ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r6.speaker: الفراء
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r6.claim: Al-Farrāʾ permits the assimilation, citing the poetic phrase taʿī as a parallel; al-Ālūsī concludes that the reading is irregular.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r6.anchor: والفراء أجاز ذلك واحتج بقوله تمشي بشدة فتعي يريد فتعيا وبالجملة القراءة شاذة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r7.claim: Several reports say the Prophet would respond to this verse by glorifying God and affirming ‘yes’; one wording adds then ‘yes.’
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r7.anchor: وجاء في عدة أخبار أن النبي صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم كان إذا قرأ هذه الآية قال سبحانك اللهم وبلى وفي بعضها سبحانك فبلى

ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r8.speaker: أبو هريرة
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r8.claim: Abū Hurayra reports the Prophet’s instruction to answer the closing questions at al-Tīn, al-Qiyāma, and al-Mursalāt affirmatively; al-Ḥākim authenticated this report.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p150#3/r8.anchor: وأخرج أحمد وأبود داود والترمذي وابن المنذر وابن مردويه والبيهقي والحاكم وصححه عن أبي هريرة قال قال رسول الله

DURR-FULL:v8p363/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r3.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r3.claim: Qatada reports that the Prophet would answer this verse with “Subḥānahu wa-balā.”
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r3.anchor: أن نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يقول إذا قرأها: سبحانه وبلى

DURR-FULL:v8p363/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r4.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r4.claim: Salih Abu al-Khalil reports the Prophet answering, “Glory be to my Lord, indeed.”
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r4.anchor: عن صالح أبي الخليل قال: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا قرأ هذه الآية {أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى} قال: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: سبحان ربي وبلى

DURR-FULL:v8p363/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r5.speaker: أبو هريرة
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r5.claim: Abu Hurayra reports that the Prophet would say, “Glory be to You, O God, indeed.”
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r5.anchor: عن أبي هريرة أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا قرأ {أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى} قال: سبحانك اللهم وبلى

DURR-FULL:v8p363/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r6.speaker: أبو أمامة
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r6.claim: Abu Umama heard the Prophet frequently recite Surat al-Qiyama and answer this verse, “Indeed, and I am among those who testify.”
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r6.anchor: عن أبي أمامة قال: صليت مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بعد حجته فكان يكثر من قراءة {لا أقسم بيوم القيامة}

DURR-FULL:v8p363/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r7.speaker: موسى بن أبي عائشة
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r7.claim: Musa ibn Abi ʿAʾisha reports a man saying this response in prayer and explaining that he heard it from the Prophet.
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r7.anchor: عن موسى بن أبي عائشة قال: كان رجل يصلي فوق بيته فكان إذا قرأ {أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى}

DURR-FULL:v8p363/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r8.speaker: أبو هريرة
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r8.claim: The Prophet instructs reciters to answer the ends of al-Tin with “Indeed, I testify,” al-Qiyama with “Indeed,” and al-Mursalat with “We believe in God”; al-Hakim authenticated the report.
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r8.anchor: عن أبي هريرة قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: من قرأ منكم (والتين والزيتون) فانتهى إلى آخرها

DURR-FULL:v8p363/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r9.speaker: جابر بن عبد الله
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r9.claim: Jabir ibn ʿAbd Allah reports the Prophet instructing the reader to say “Indeed” upon reaching this verse.
DURR-FULL:v8p363/r9.anchor: عن جابر بن عبد الله قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: إذا قرأت {لا أقسم بيوم القيامة} فبلغت

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3389#4/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3389#4/r1.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3389#4/r1.claim: A reciter says he heard the Prophet say to answer this verse with Subhanaka Allahumma, qabli.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3389#4/r1.anchor: قال : سبحانك اللهم ، قبلي . فسئل عن ذلك فقال : سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ذلك .

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3389#4/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3389#4/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3389#4/r2.claim: When Ibn Abbas came upon this verse, he said Subhanaka, qabli.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3389#4/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس انه مر بهذه الاية اليس ذلك بقادر علي ان يحيي الموتى قال : سبحانك ، قبلي .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p366/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p366/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p366/r4.claim: Verses 37–40 argue that creating a human from weak material through successive stages proves God can recreate him after his parts decay; this prepares the question in 75:40 and echoes 21:104.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p366/r4.anchor: أي أن خلق الإنسان من مادة ضعيفة وتدرجه في أطوار كيانه دليل على إثبات القدرة على إنشائه إنشاء ثانيا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p426#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p426#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p426#3/r1.claim: The one who performed the first creation is surely able to revive the dead: whoever can originate can restore.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p426#3/r1.anchor: وهذا تقرير لهم أي إن من قدر على الابتداء قدر على الإعادة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p426#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p426#3/r2.speaker: أبو بكر الصديق وأبو رجاء وعاصم الجحدري
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p426#3/r2.claim: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq, Abu Raja, and Asim al-Jahdari read yaqdiru, a finite verb, rather than the usual qadir.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p426#3/r2.anchor: وقرأ أبو بكر الصديق وأبو رجاء وعاصم الجحدري يقدر على أن يحيي الموتى

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p426#3/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p426#3/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p426#3/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas says that whoever recites this verse should answer: O God, indeed You are able.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p426#3/r3.anchor: قال ابن عباس إذا قرأ أحدكم هذه الآية فليقل اللهم بلى

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p665/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p665/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p665/r3.claim: The one who originated this creation is surely able to restore it.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p665/r3.anchor: { أليس ذلك } الذي أنشأ هذا الإنشاء { بقادر } على الإعادة .

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p665/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p665/r4.speaker: رسول الله
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p665/r4.claim: A report says the Prophet would answer this verse when reciting it with ‘Glory be to You, yes indeed.’
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p665/r4.anchor: أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا قرأها قال ( سبحانك بلى ) .

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p665/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p665/r5.speaker: رسول الله
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p665/r5.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet promises that he and Gabriel will testify on Resurrection Day that the reciter believed in it; no grading is stated.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p665/r5.anchor: من قرأ سورة القيامة شهدت له أنا وجبريل يوم القيامة أنه كان مؤمنا بيوم القيامة

NASAFI-FULL:v4p302/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p302/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p302/r1.claim: The one who performed these acts is able to bring the dead back to life.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p302/r1.anchor: اليس الفعال لهذه الاشياء بقادر على الاعادة

NASAFI-FULL:v4p302/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p302/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
NASAFI-FULL:v4p302/r2.claim: When reciting this verse, the Prophet would answer, Glory be to You, indeed; no grading is stated.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p302/r2.anchor: وكان صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا قراها يقول سبحانك ببلى

RAZI-FULL:v30p207#3/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p207#3/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p207#3/r2.claim: The one who originated these things is surely able to bring the dead back to life.
RAZI-FULL:v30p207#3/r2.anchor: والمعنى أليس ذلك الذي أنشأ هذه الأشياء بقادر على الإعادة ،

RAZI-FULL:v30p207#3/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p207#3/r3.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
RAZI-FULL:v30p207#3/r3.claim: A report says that when the Prophet recited this verse he said, “Glory to You; yes indeed, and praise belongs to God, Lord of all worlds.”
RAZI-FULL:v30p207#3/r3.anchor: روي أنه صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا قرأها قال : سبحانك بلى والحمد لله رب العالمين

TAB-FULL:v23p527/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p527/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p527/r3.claim: The one who made humans from a drop through these stages can resurrect the dead and restore them as they were; creating a person from semen proves this is no difficulty.
TAB-FULL:v23p527/r3.anchor: يقول تعالى ذكره: أليس الذي فعل ذلك فخلق هذا الإنسان من نطفة

TAB-FULL:v23p527/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p527/r4.speaker: رسول الله
TAB-FULL:v23p527/r4.claim: The Prophet is reported to answer “Indeed” when reciting this verse.
TAB-FULL:v23p527/r4.anchor: وكان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا قرأ ذلك قال: «بلى»

TAB-FULL:v23p527/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p527/r5.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v23p527/r5.claim: Qatāda reports that the Prophet would say “Glory be to You, and indeed” when reciting it.
TAB-FULL:v23p527/r5.anchor: عن قتادة، قوله: {أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى}

AKHFASH:v1p350/r6.author: al-Akhfash al-Awsaṭ
AKHFASH:v1p350/r6.speaker: author
AKHFASH:v1p350/r6.claim: Without a required fatḥa assimilation need not occur, as in أن يحيي الموتى; the verb can remain unassimilated or be softened.
AKHFASH:v1p350/r6.anchor: فاذا كان في موضع لا يلزمه الفتح لم يدغم نحو {بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى}

TABATABAI:75:36/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:75:36/r8.speaker: البراء بن عازب
TABATABAI:75:36/r8.claim: Al-Bara ibn ʿAzib reports that when 75:40 was revealed, the Prophet answered it with Subhanaka Allahumma wa bala, Glory to You, God, yes indeed.

TABATABAI:75:36/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:75:36/r9.speaker: أبو جعفر وأبو عبد الله عليهما السلام
TABATABAI:75:36/r9.claim: The same response to 75:40 is also reported from Abu Jaʿfar and Abu ʿAbd Allah.
TABATABAI:75:36/r9.anchor: وروي ذلك عن أبي جعفر وأبي عبد الله عليهما السلام

TABATABAI:75:36/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:75:36/r10.speaker: أبو هريرة
TABATABAI:75:36/r10.claim: Al-Durr al-Manthur reports from Abu Hurayra and others that the Prophet said Glory to You, God, yes indeed whenever he recited this verse.
TABATABAI:75:36/r10.anchor: وروي في الدر المنثور عن أبي هريرة وغيره أنه صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم إذا قرأ الآية قال سبحانك اللهم وبلى

TABATABAI:75:36/r11.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:75:36/r11.speaker: الرضا عليه السلام
TABATABAI:75:36/r11.claim: Al-ʿUyun reports that al-Rida said Glory to You, God, yes indeed at the end whenever he recited the surah.
TABATABAI:75:36/r11.anchor: وكذا في العيون عن الرضا عليه السلام أنه كان إذا قرأ السورة قال عند الفراغ سبحانك اللهم بلى

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p529/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p529/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p529/r5.claim: The one who did this initial creation can resurrect the dead; dhālika refers to God, the implied agent in “He created and fashioned.”
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p529/r5.anchor: من قدر على الابتداء قدر على البعث بعد الموت

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p529/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p529/r6.speaker: النبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p529/r6.claim: The Prophet used to say “Glory to You, O God, yes indeed” when reciting this verse.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p529/r6.anchor: وكان النبي -صلى الله عليه وسلم- إذا قرأ هذه الآية قال: "سبحانك اللهم فبلى" (¬7)

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p529/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p529/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p529/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas says that when reciting the surah and reaching the verse, one should say “Our Lord, yes indeed.”
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p529/r7.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: إذا قرأت هذه السورة (فقلت) (¬1): {أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى (40)} [فقل] (¬2): اللهم ربنا فبلى

STUDYQURAN:75:37/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:75:37/r2.speaker: Prophet
STUDYQURAN:75:37/r2.claim: The Prophet reportedly answered “Yea!” after reciting whether God can give life to the dead, and advised others to answer likewise.
STUDYQURAN:75:37/r2.anchor: It is reported that when the Prophet recited, Is not such a one able to give life

TAB:87:1/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:87:1/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB:87:1/r6.claim: When Ibn Abbas reached the end of Surat al-Qiyama, he answered its question with Subhanaka Allahumma wa bala.
TAB:87:1/r6.anchor: عن أبي إسحاق الهمْداني ، أن ابن عباس كان إذا قرأ

TABATABAI:75:36-39/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:75:36-39/r8.speaker: author
TABATABAI:75:36-39/r8.claim: The verse argues for resurrection from God's universal power and His proven ability to create initially; bringing back the dead is easier than beginning creation.
TABATABAI:75:36-39/r8.anchor: احتجاج على البعث الذي ينكرونه استبعادا له بعموم القدرة وثبوتها على الخلق الابتدائي والإعادة لا تزيد على الابتداء مؤنة بل هي أهون

TABRISI:75:37-40/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:75:37-40/r9.speaker: author
TABRISI:75:37-40/r9.claim: The one who initiated life by developing a drop into a living person with five senses, specialized organs, and reproductive pairs can restore that person after death.
TABRISI:75:37-40/r9.anchor: من قدر على جعل النطفة علقة والعلقة مضغة إلى أن يجعلها حيا سليما مركبا فيه الحواس الخمس

TABRISI:75:37-40/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:75:37-40/r10.speaker: رسول الله
TABRISI:75:37-40/r10.claim: Al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib reports that when the verse was revealed, the Messenger said, Glory be to You, O God, yes indeed; the same is reported from Abū Jaʿfar and Abū ʿAbd Allāh.
TABRISI:75:37-40/r10.anchor: وجاء في الحديث عن البراء بن عازب قال

TABRISI:75:37-40/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:75:37-40/r11.speaker: author
TABRISI:75:37-40/r11.claim: The verse establishes the validity of rational analogy: God points from the first creation to the second.
TABRISI:75:37-40/r11.anchor: وفي الآية دلالة على صحة القياس العقلي فإنه سبحانه اعتبر النشأة الثانية بالنشأة الأولى

BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r10.claim: The one who made this remarkable creation can raise the dead; rationally, resurrection is easier than origination because primordial matter and the original elements remain.
BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r10.anchor: وهو أهون من البدء في قياس العقل لوجود المادة وهو عجب الذنب والعناصر الأصلية

BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r11.speaker: النبي عليه السلام
BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r11.claim: The Prophet would answer the verse when reciting it, “Glory be to You, O God—indeed”; another version has him repeat “Indeed, by God” twice, affirming resurrection and God’s power.
BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r11.anchor: أن النبي عليه السلام كان إذا قرأها قال سبحانك اللهم بلى

BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r12.speaker: ابن عباس
BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r12.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says a reciter of al-Aʿlā should say “Glory to my Lord, the Most High,” and at the end of al-Qiyāmah should say “Glory be to You, O God—indeed,” whether leading prayer or not.
BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r12.anchor: وقال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما من قرأ سبح اسم ربك الأعلى إما ما كان أو غيره

BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r13.speaker: النبي
BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r13.claim: A hadith instructs reciters of al-Tīn, al-Qiyāmah, and al-Mursalāt to answer their closing questions with affirmation and witness, “Glory be to You—indeed,” and “We believe in God,” respectively.
BURSEVI:v10p199#2/r13.anchor: من قرأ منكم والتين والزيتون فانتهى إلى آخرها أليس بالله بأحكم الحاكمين

THALABI:v10p92/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p92/r6.speaker: النبي
THALABI:v10p92/r6.claim: Al-Baraʾ ibn ʿAzib reports that when this verse was revealed, the Prophet said, “Glory be to You, indeed.”
THALABI:v10p92/r6.anchor: عن البراء بن عازب قال: لما نزلت هذه الآية أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى قال رسول الله (عليه السلام) : «سبحانك وبلى»

THALABI:v10p92/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p92/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
THALABI:v10p92/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas says a reader of al-Aʿla should say “Glory to my Lord Most High,” and a reader reaching the end of al-Qiyama should say “Glory be to You, O God, indeed,” whether leading prayer or not.
THALABI:v10p92/r7.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير عن عبد الله بن عباس قال: من قرأ سبح اسم ربك الأعلى

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:75:30-40/r10.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:75:30-40/r10.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:75:30-40/r10.claim: The One who did this is surely able to resurrect the dead and has power over all things.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:75:30-40/r10.anchor: الذي فعل هذا { بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى }؟ [بلى، وهو على كل شيء قدير].

ELMALILI:75:36-40/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:75:36-40/r3.speaker: Ebû Hüreyre
ELMALILI:75:36-40/r3.claim: A report from Abu Hurayra, going back to the Prophet and transmitted by Ahmad, Abu Dawud, Hakim, Bayhaqi and others, says to answer “balā” at this sūra’s end, “āmanna bi-llāh” at al-Mursalāt’s end, and “balā wa-anā ʿalā dhālikum mina-sh-shāhidīn” at al-Tīn’s end.
ELMALILI:75:36-40/r3.anchor: Resûlullah’tan Ebû Hüreyre hadîsiyle, Ahmed, Ebû Dâvûd, Hâkim, Beyhakī gibi muhaddisîn ve müfessirîn tarafından rivayet edilmiştir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r4.claim: After recalling human creation, the surah ends by warning in a question that the power which created humans will also resurrect the dead.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:75:31/r4.anchor: bu gücün ölüleri de dirilteceğini bildiren uyarı âyetiyle sona ermektedir.

BURHAN:v3p83/r7.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p83/r7.speaker: ابن عصفور
BURHAN:v3p83/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAsfur says bāʾ is exceptionally augmentative in a rare, non-analogical construction such as “بقادر”; the author identifies the intended verse and cites its parallel without bāʾ as evidence.
BURHAN:v3p83/r7.anchor: وقال ابن عصفور في المقرب 9 وتزاد في نادر كلام لا يقاس عليه

ITQAN:v1p235/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p235/r6.speaker: author
ITQAN:v1p235/r6.claim: Of twenty-two Qur’anic “balā” occurrences, seven cannot be paused at by agreement because the next words are attached syntactically.
ITQAN:v1p235/r6.anchor: بل في القرآن في اثنين وعشرين موضعا وهي ثلاثة أقسام الأول ما لا يجوز الوقف عليها إجماعا لتعليق ما بعدها بما قبلها

ITQAN:v1p283/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p283/r4.speaker: author
ITQAN:v1p283/r4.claim: Suyuti cites a report instructing readers to answer the endings of al-Tin and al-Qiyama with “yes,” and the ending of al-Mursalat with “we believe in God.”
ITQAN:v1p283/r4.anchor: أخرج أبو داود والترمذي حديث من قرأ ﴿ والتين والزيتون ﴾ فانتهى إلى آخرها فليقل بلى

ZAJJAJ:v5p254/r8.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p254/r8.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p254/r8.claim: After recalling creation from a drop, the passage asks whether the one who formed the sexes is not capable of bringing the dead to life.
ZAJJAJ:v5p254/r8.anchor: (أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى (40)

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p189/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p189/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p189/r1.claim: Across these interrogatives about laysa-negated propositions, the negation is overturned into definite affirmation; the ba consistently accompanies the predicate.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p189/r1.anchor: النفي في هذه الآيات جميعاً قد انتقض وخرج إلى تقرير باتَّ وإثبات حاسم

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p189/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p189/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p189/r2.claim: Although rhetoricians recognize that interrogatives can shift into assertion or other functions, the ba's regular presence here contributes to the declarative force.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p189/r2.anchor: ومن حيث اطرد اقتران الخبر فيها بالباء، تعين أن يكون لهذه الباء أثرها في الدلالة البيانية

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p1069/r4.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p1069/r4.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p1069/r4.claim: The Quran also reasons from human development from semen through a clinging clot and formation, including the creation of male and female, to God's power to resurrect.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p1069/r4.anchor: أحياناً يستدل بالحياة الآخرة على خلق الإنسان وتطوره (أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِنْ مَنِيٍّ يُمْنَى (37) ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّى (38)

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p84/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p84/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p84/r5.claim: The sūrah ends where it began: after discussing arrogance and Judgement, it returns to the opening doubt about resurrection in 75:3–4 and asks whether a person will be left unaccountable.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p84/r5.anchor: Here in these verses, the sūrah ends on the subject with which it began.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p84/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p84/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p84/r6.claim: He frames leaving people unaccountable as a violation of God’s justice and wisdom.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p84/r6.anchor: if leaving him unaccountable is against the justice and wisdom of the

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p287/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p287/r7.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p287/r7.claim: The one who performed this creation can certainly bring the dead to life.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p287/r7.anchor: الذي فعل هذا {بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى}

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p287/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p287/r8.speaker: أبو هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p287/r8.claim: Abu Hurayra reports the Prophet's instruction to answer yes after reciting the endings of al-Tin and al-Qiyama, and to say We believe in God after al-Mursalat's final question.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p287/r8.anchor: أبا هريرة يقول: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p287/r9.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p287/r9.speaker: رجل عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p287/r9.claim: An unnamed man praying on a rooftop said Subhanaka, yes when he recited this verse, and said he had heard this response from the Prophet.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p287/r9.anchor: حدثنا شعبة، عن موسى بن أبي عائشة قال: كان رجل يصلي فوق بيته

BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r8.claim: Distinguishing male from female out of one drop is subtler than separating a dead person's dust from earth, proving God's power to reassemble the dead.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r8.anchor: تمييز ما يصلح منه للذكر وما يصلح منه للأنثى أشد وأخفى من تمييز تراب الميت من تراب الأرض

BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r10.claim: The perfected first creation refutes hesitation about resurrection: the supreme Creator can revive the dead however He wills, all at once or successively.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r10.anchor: أي الخالق المسوي الإله الأعظم الذي قدر على هذه الإنشاءات وصنع هذه الصنائع المتقنة

BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r11.claim: The sūra's conclusion returns to its opening by joining the collection of bones with resurrection for the Day of Gathering.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r11.anchor: وقد رجع آخر السورة على أولها أتم رجوع

BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r12.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r12.claim: Abu Hurayra reports the Prophet's instruction: after reciting the cited endings of al-Tin, al-Qiyama, or al-Mursalat, respond respectively as a witness, with yes, or with belief in God.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r12.anchor: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال : رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r13.speaker: الترمذي
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r13.claim: Al-Tirmidhi transmits the response at the end of al-Qiyama as yes, by the might of our Lord.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r13.anchor: ورواه الترمذي وقال في آخر القيامة أن يحيي الموتى . ( بلى وعزة ربنا )

BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r14.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r14.speaker: الحافظ نور الدين الهيثمي
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r14.claim: Al-Haythami says Ahmad also narrated the recitation-response report, but its chain contains two men he did not know.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p257/r14.anchor: وقال الحافظ نور الدين الهيثمي في مجمع الزوائد : وروى أحمد وفيه رجلان لم أعرفهما

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r10.claim: The closing rhetorical question rebukes and establishes God's power to resurrect the dead.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r10.anchor: ثم وقف تعالى توقيف التوبيخ وإقامة الحجة بقوله: أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r11.speaker: جمهور القراء
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r11.claim: The majority read the final ya of يحيي with a fatḥa.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r11.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور بفتح الياء الأخيرة من «يحيي»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r12.speaker: طلحة بن مصرف، سليمان، الفياض بن غزوان
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r12.claim: These readers give the final ya sukūn; it disappears in pronunciation before the lām-sukūn in الموتى.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r12.anchor: وقرأ طلحة بن مصرف وسليمان والفياض بن غزوان بسكونها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r13.speaker: النبي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r13.claim: The Prophet is reported to have answered this verse with سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك وبلى, or simply بلى.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p407/r13.anchor: ويروى أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا قرأ هذه الآية قال

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p283#2/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p283#2/r7.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p283#2/r7.claim: The One who formed a sound human from a weak drop can surely restore the dead as He first created them.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p283#2/r7.anchor: أي: أما هذا الذي أنشأ هذا الخلق السوي من هذه النطفة الضعيفة بقادر على أن يعيده كما بدأه؟

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p283#2/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p283#2/r8.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p283#2/r8.claim: One view makes resurrection easier than initial creation; another says the two are equal, as reflected in the two readings of the argument in 30:27. Ibn Kathir says the first view is more famous.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p283#2/r8.anchor: وتناول القدرة للإعادة إما بطريق الأولى بالنسبة إلى البداءة، وإما مساوية على القولين في قوله: {وهو الذي يبدأ الخلق ثم يعيده وهو أهون عليه} [الروم:27] .

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p283#2/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p283#2/r9.speaker: محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p283#2/r9.claim: A man reciting on a roof answered this verse with praise and assent, saying he had heard the Prophet do so.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p283#2/r9.anchor: فسئل عن ذلك فقال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ذلك.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r1.claim: Abu Dawud alone transmits the preceding report; its Companion narrator is unnamed, which Ibn Kathir says does not matter.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r1.anchor: تفرد به أبو داود (2) ولم يسم هذا الصحابي، ولا يضر ذلك.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r2.speaker: أبو هريرة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r2.claim: Abu Hurayra reports the Prophet's recitation responses: say assent after the endings of al-Tin and al-Qiyama, and affirm belief after the closing question in al-Mursalat; Ibn Kathir cites transmission by Abu Dawud, Ahmad, and al-Tirmidhi.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r2.anchor: سمعت أبا هريرة يقول: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "من قرأ منكم بالتين والزيتون

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r3.speaker: قتادة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r3.claim: Qatada says the Prophet used to respond to this verse, when reciting it, with praise and assent.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r3.anchor: عن قتادة، قوله: {أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى} ذكر لنا أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا قرأها قال: "سبحانك وبلى"

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas is reported to have answered the verse himself, saying, Praise be to You; yes indeed.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p284/r4.anchor: عن ابن عباس أنه مر بهذه الآية: {أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى} ؟، قال: سبحانك؛ فبلى.

JISHUMI:v10p7196/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7196/r7.speaker: الفراء
JISHUMI:v10p7196/r7.claim: Readers pronounce the phrase with clear articulation; al-Farrāʾ permits assimilation by moving the vowel to the ḥāʾ and cites a line for the form.
JISHUMI:v10p7196/r7.anchor: القراء (على أن يحيي الموتى) بالإظهار، وأجاز الفراء بالإدغام

JISHUMI:v10p7196/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7196/r8.speaker: البراء بن عازب
JISHUMI:v10p7196/r8.claim: Al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib reports that when the verse asking whether God can resurrect the dead was revealed, the Prophet said, Glorified are You, indeed You can.
JISHUMI:v10p7196/r8.anchor: عن البراء بن عازب: لما نزلت هذه الآية: (أليس ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى)

JISHUMI:v10p7196/r18.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7196/r18.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7196/r18.claim: The One who created human beings in these stages can resurrect the dead for judgment and recompense.
JISHUMI:v10p7196/r18.anchor: من جعل ذلك بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى للبعث والجزاء

MUQATIL:75:34-40/r7.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:75:34-40/r7.speaker: author
MUQATIL:75:34-40/r7.claim: The One who originated this human being is surely able to resurrect the dead.
MUQATIL:75:34-40/r7.anchor: { أليس ذلك } يعني أما ذلك { بقادر } الذي بدأ خلق هذا الإنسان { على أن يحيي الموتى } [آية: 40]

QURTUBI-FULL:75:36-40/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:75:36-40/r12.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:75:36-40/r12.claim: The one who created a person from a drop can restore the dead bodily after decay.
QURTUBI-FULL:75:36-40/r12.anchor: أي أليس الذي قدر على خلق هذه النسمة من قطرة من ماء

QURTUBI-FULL:75:36-40/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:75:36-40/r13.speaker: النبي
QURTUBI-FULL:75:36-40/r13.claim: The Prophet is reported to say Subḥānaka Allāhumma balā when reciting this verse.
QURTUBI-FULL:75:36-40/r13.anchor: وروي عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: أنه كان إذا قرأها قال

QURTUBI-FULL:75:36-40/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:75:36-40/r14.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:75:36-40/r14.claim: Ibn Abbas says to respond to al-Aʿlā with Subḥāna rabbī al-aʿlā and to the end of this sūra with Subḥānaka Allāhumma balā, whether leading prayer or not.
QURTUBI-FULL:75:36-40/r14.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: من قرأ سبح اسم ربك الأعلى
